{{Top|leg}}
'''Exhaust vanes''' were components of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]]. They were used in conjunction with [[intake]] mechanisms to control the movement of the jetpack. Setting exhaust vanes to oppose one other allowed the operator to hover with the jetpack.
